repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until((#Stop_Button).button_button == "pushed" and triggered == false, edge rising)
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#Stop_Button).button_button == "pushed")
all(#Switch).switch_off()
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate polls the button state only at the start of the 1-second cycle period. The IR requires a rising-edge wait, meaning the action must fire immediately when the button transitions to 'pushed', even if that happens mid-period. The candidate fails to observe the event between iterations.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with a blocking rising-edge wait (`wait until(..., edge rising)`) followed by the action and a state flag to prevent re-firing on a held condition. This ensures the action fires at the exact moment of the transition, matching the IR's `wait` semantics.
